from datetime import timedelta
from types import SimpleNamespace

import numpy as np
import pytest

from skrub import DurationEncoder
from skrub import _dataframe as sbd
from skrub._single_column_transformer import RejectColumn


def duration_column(df_module, values=None, name="dur"):
    if values is None:
        values = [
            timedelta(days=2, hours=5, minutes=3, seconds=4, microseconds=5000),
            None,
            timedelta(days=1, hours=1, minutes=1, seconds=1),
        ]
    return df_module.make_column(name, values)


@pytest.fixture
def duration_col(df_module):
    return duration_column(df_module)


def test_importable():
    from skrub import DurationEncoder as DE

    assert DE is DurationEncoder


def test_fit_transform(df_module, duration_col, use_fit_transform):
    encoder = DurationEncoder()
    if use_fit_transform:
        out = encoder.fit_transform(duration_col)
    else:
        encoder.fit(duration_col)
        out = encoder.transform(duration_col)
    expected = df_module.make_dataframe(
        {
            "dur_total_seconds": [190984.005, None, 90061.0],
            "dur_days": [2.0, None, 1.0],
            "dur_hours": [5.0, None, 1.0],
            "dur_minutes": [3.0, None, 1.0],
            "dur_seconds": [4.0, None, 1.0],
            "dur_microseconds": [5000.0, None, 0.0],
            "dur_log1p_total_seconds": [
                np.log1p(190984.005),
                None,
                np.log1p(90061.0),
            ],
        }
    )
    # Reorder to encoder's output order.
    expected = expected[encoder.all_outputs_]
    df_module.assert_frame_equal(out, expected)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "resolution, expected_components",
    [
        ("day", ["total_seconds", "days", "log1p_total_seconds"]),
        (
            "hour",
            ["total_seconds", "days", "hours", "log1p_total_seconds"],
        ),
        (
            "minute",
            [
                "total_seconds",
                "days",
                "hours",
                "minutes",
                "log1p_total_seconds",
            ],
        ),
        (
            "second",
            [
                "total_seconds",
                "days",
                "hours",
                "minutes",
                "seconds",
                "log1p_total_seconds",
            ],
        ),
        (
            "microsecond",
            [
                "total_seconds",
                "days",
                "hours",
                "minutes",
                "seconds",
                "microseconds",
                "log1p_total_seconds",
            ],
        ),
    ],
)
def test_resolution_components(
    df_module, duration_col, resolution, expected_components
):
    encoder = DurationEncoder(resolution=resolution)
    encoder.fit_transform(duration_col)
    assert encoder.components_ == expected_components
    assert encoder.all_outputs_ == [
        f"dur_{component}" for component in expected_components
    ]
    assert list(sbd.column_names(encoder.fit_transform(duration_col))) == encoder.all_outputs_


def test_auto_resolution_day(df_module):
    col = df_module.make_column(
        "dur", [timedelta(days=1), None, timedelta(days=3)]
    )
    encoder = DurationEncoder()
    encoder.fit_transform(col)
    assert encoder.resolution_ == "day"
    assert encoder.components_ == [
        "total_seconds",
        "days",
        "log1p_total_seconds",
    ]


def test_auto_resolution_hour(df_module):
    col = df_module.make_column(
        "dur", [timedelta(hours=1), timedelta(days=1, hours=2)]
    )
    encoder = DurationEncoder()
    encoder.fit_transform(col)
    assert encoder.resolution_ == "hour"


def test_auto_resolution_all_null(df_module):
    if df_module.name == "pandas":
        import pandas as pd

        col = pd.Series([None, None], name="dur", dtype="timedelta64[us]")
    else:
        import polars as pl

        col = pl.Series("dur", [None, None], dtype=pl.Duration("us"))
    encoder = DurationEncoder()
    encoder.fit_transform(col)
    assert encoder.resolution_ == "minute"
    assert encoder.components_ == [
        "total_seconds",
        "days",
        "hours",
        "minutes",
        "log1p_total_seconds",
    ]


def test_explicit_components(df_module, duration_col):
    encoder = DurationEncoder(
        components=["cos_of_day", "total_seconds", "sin_of_day", "days"],
        resolution="microsecond",
    )
    out = encoder.fit_transform(duration_col)
    assert encoder.components_ == [
        "total_seconds",
        "days",
        "sin_of_day",
        "cos_of_day",
    ]
    assert list(sbd.column_names(out)) == encoder.all_outputs_
    assert encoder.resolution_ is None


def test_explicit_components_ignores_resolution(df_module, duration_col):
    # resolution is ignored (and not validated) when components is explicit
    encoder = DurationEncoder(components=["days"], resolution="bogus")
    encoder.fit_transform(duration_col)
    assert encoder.components_ == ["days"]


def test_invalid_components_type(df_module, duration_col):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="components"):
        DurationEncoder(components=42).fit_transform(duration_col)


def test_invalid_components_names(df_module, duration_col):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unknown component"):
        DurationEncoder(components=["days", "bogus"]).fit_transform(duration_col)


def test_invalid_resolution(df_module, duration_col):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="resolution"):
        DurationEncoder(resolution="bogus").fit_transform(duration_col)


def test_invalid_handle_negative(df_module, duration_col):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="handle_negative"):
        DurationEncoder(handle_negative="bogus").fit_transform(duration_col)


def test_invalid_scaling(df_module, duration_col):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="scaling"):
        DurationEncoder(scaling="bogus").fit_transform(duration_col)


def test_reject_non_duration(df_module):
    col = df_module.make_column("x", [1, 2, 3])
    with pytest.raises(RejectColumn, match="Duration"):
        DurationEncoder().fit_transform(col)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("handle_negative", ["clip", "abs", "keep"])
def test_handle_negative(df_module, handle_negative):
    col = df_module.make_column(
        "dur",
        [timedelta(days=-1, hours=-2), timedelta(days=1), None],
    )
    encoder = DurationEncoder(resolution="day", handle_negative=handle_negative)
    out = encoder.fit_transform(col)
    if handle_negative == "clip":
        expected = [0.0, 86400.0, None]
    elif handle_negative == "abs":
        expected = [93600.0, 86400.0, None]
    else:
        expected = [-93600.0, 86400.0, None]
    values = sbd.to_list(out["dur_total_seconds"])
    assert values == expected


def test_handle_negative_auto_resolution(df_module):
    # With clip, all values become whole days/zero so resolution is day
    col = df_module.make_column(
        "dur", [timedelta(days=-1, hours=-2), timedelta(days=1)]
    )
    encoder = DurationEncoder(handle_negative="clip")
    encoder.fit_transform(col)
    assert encoder.resolution_ == "day"


def test_null_propagation(df_module):
    col = df_module.make_column("dur", [timedelta(days=1), None])
    out = DurationEncoder(resolution="day").fit_transform(col)
    if df_module.name == "pandas":
        assert out.iloc[1].isna().all()
    else:
        assert out.row(1) == (None, None, None)


def test_transform_after_fit(df_module):
    encoder = DurationEncoder(resolution="day").fit(
        df_module.make_column("dur", [timedelta(days=1)])
    )
    out = encoder.transform(df_module.make_column("dur", [timedelta(days=2)]))
    assert sbd.to_list(out["dur_total_seconds"]) == [172800.0]


def test_get_feature_names_out(df_module, duration_col):
    encoder = DurationEncoder(resolution="day")
    encoder.fit_transform(duration_col)
    assert encoder.get_feature_names_out() == [
        "dur_total_seconds",
        "dur_days",
        "dur_log1p_total_seconds",
    ]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "scaling, expected_first, expected_second",
    [
        ("minmax", 0.0, 1.0),
        ("standard", -1.0, 1.0),
        ("robust", -1.0, 1.0),
    ],
)
def test_scaling(df_module, scaling, expected_first, expected_second):
    col = df_module.make_column(
        "dur", [timedelta(days=1), timedelta(days=3)]
    )
    encoder = DurationEncoder(resolution="day", scaling=scaling)
    out = encoder.fit_transform(col)
    values = sbd.to_list(out["dur_total_seconds"])
    assert np.isclose(values[0], expected_first)
    assert np.isclose(values[1], expected_second)
    assert set(encoder.scaling_params_) == set(encoder.components_)
    assert "total_seconds" in encoder.scaling_params_


def test_scaling_unseen_clip(df_module):
    col = df_module.make_column("dur", [timedelta(days=1), timedelta(days=3)])
    encoder = DurationEncoder(resolution="day", scaling="minmax")
    encoder.fit(col)
    out = encoder.transform(
        df_module.make_column("dur", [timedelta(days=5), timedelta(days=0)])
    )
    values = sbd.to_list(out["dur_total_seconds"])
    assert values == [1.0, 0.0]


def test_scaling_constant_column(df_module):
    col = df_module.make_column("dur", [timedelta(days=2), timedelta(days=2)])
    for scaling in ["minmax", "standard", "robust"]:
        encoder = DurationEncoder(resolution="day", scaling=scaling)
        out = encoder.fit_transform(col)
        values = sbd.to_list(out["dur_total_seconds"])
        assert all(np.isclose(v, 0.0) for v in values)


def test_microsecond_precision(df_module):
    col = df_module.make_column(
        "dur",
        [timedelta(days=1, microseconds=1000001), timedelta(microseconds=1)],
    )
    encoder = DurationEncoder(resolution="microsecond")
    out = encoder.fit_transform(col)
    assert sbd.to_list(out["dur_microseconds"]) == [1.0, 1.0]
